notes.title: Sound Tracks DLC
notes.content:
If you like music in the game, now you have opportunity to hear all tracks of the composer WHALESFLY.

Original collection of atmospheric music from 15 tracks, including soundtracks for the game is now available as an add-on: Ghost Stories - Soundtracks DLC

[b]Track list - all songs in MP3 format:[/b]

[list]
[*] WHALESFLY - FREE AGAIN
[*] WHALESFLY - GHOST STORIES PART 1
[*] WHALESFLY - GHOST STORIES PART 2
[*] WHALESFLY - GHOST STORIES TRAILER
[*] WHALESFLY - GROAN
[*] WHALESFLY - INTRO
[*] WHALESFLY - JESS
[*] WHALESFLY - MY FAREWELL
[*] WHALESFLY - NYCTOPHOBIA
[*] WHALESFLY - OPEN THE GATE
[*] WHALESFLY - OVERDOSE

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content:
A small update and fix some bugs:

- At death, flashlight is worked.
- At death, menu of the last game save is now called.
- Fix some doors.
- Accelerated screamer head Max.
- Fixed bug with notes.
- Some bugs fixed.
